qualification_decision.reason: No reviewed candidate simultaneously provides independent time-resolved pressure and outlet flow or mass, exact hydraulic geometry, timing, preparation metadata, rights, and a measurement-uncertainty basis.

required: time-resolved pressure at a physically identified node
time-resolved outlet flow or cumulative mass
basket hydraulic area or complete geometry
dose, coffee, grinder, preparation, basket, machine, and temperature metadata
measurement resolution or uncertainty sufficient to set thresholds
no use in WP02 closure selection or parameter choice
rights permitting governed analysis and publication of derived metrics

score_bearing_values_sealed_until: persistent dataset identity and hashes are frozen
physical mappings and timing rules are frozen
thresholds are derived from measurement uncertainty

predeclared_evaluation_template.physical_mapping: Use measured basket-node pressure as the absolute Darcy boundary; do not substitute pump pressure without a separately verified transfer function.
predeclared_evaluation_template.timing_alignment: Use the dataset's physical timing origin; no result-selected shift. If first drip is the source origin, map it once from metadata before values are opened.
predeclared_evaluation_template.interpolation: Strict monotone time interpolation inside the observed support only; no extrapolation except a separately qualified floating-representation endpoint reconciliation.
predeclared_evaluation_template.normalization: No amplitude scaling. When dimensionless shape is reported, normalize by a predeclared late-window mean that is fully inside each experiment.
predeclared_evaluation_template.comparison_interval: Must be chosen from physical stage metadata and uncertainty before holdout values are opened.
predeclared_evaluation_template.excluded_rows: Only instrument-invalid or source-declared exclusions frozen before scoring; every exclusion requires a reason and count.
predeclared_evaluation_template.groups: Every experimental unit and alias rule must be frozen before scoring.
metrics: absolute or relative flow error in physical units
Pearson correlation for nonconstant time-shape series
predeclared_evaluation_template.threshold_rule: Numerical values must be derived from the selected dataset's declared measurement uncertainty or resolution plus existing numerical-verification error, never from observed model performance.
predeclared_evaluation_template.aggregate_rule: A hydraulic claim requires every numerical, conservation, identity, and uncertainty-derived metric gate to pass; undefined correlation fails any shape claim.
predeclared_evaluation_template.numeric_thresholds_absent_reason: No qualifying dataset provides the uncertainty basis needed to set non-arbitrary thresholds.
predeclared_evaluation_template.claim_ceiling: A future passing comparison could establish transfer only for the frozen branch, measured observables, apparatus, coffee, preparation, pressure range, and time interval of the independently governed holdout. It would not validate full poroelastic deformation or universal transfer.

required_raw_channels: outlet mass from a calibrated scale
required_geometry: basket inside diameter or measured open hydraulic area

mechanism_discrimination.residual_signature: good imposed-pressure response but poor delivered-pressure response
systematic bed-height dependence or pressure-flow hysteresis
acceptable hydraulics but poor TDS or species evolution
